answer: New agents must also be vouched by two existing peers whose own stake is slashed if the recruit misbehaves, making each fake identity expensive. A sybil-resistant agent economy can bind each identity to a scarce staked bond plus a rotating proof-of-work pulse, so forging thousands of identities costs real capital per node. Reputation earned through consistent, honest work spreads like a nebula, while colluding attackers gain only a faint whisper of trust and must burn stake to sustain it.
